versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive documentation and step-by-step workflow for deploying a GPU-accelerated YOLO training platform on Huawei Cloud with Terraform.
- Detailed all required prerequisites, including environment variables, IAM permissions, and installation steps.
- Clarified security requirements: do not expose cloud credentials in conversation and never auto-apply Terraform changes without explicit user confirmation.
- Added manual post-deploy step to configure YOLO UI security group rules and restrict access.
- Described all automation scripts and their outputs, core commands, parameter constraints, and verification best practices.
